newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian public services union seeks strike action.
newsitem.headline: Belgian public services union seeks strike action.

text.p: Belgian public services union CGSP said on Monday it had contacted other government workers' unions about possible strike action against social security cuts expected to be announced in the government's 1997 budget.

"The CGSP has appealed to other union organisations representing the public sector to organise, before the end of October, protests up to and including strike action, preferably as part of wider actions," the union said in a statement.
It said union leaders would meet on October 4, after presentation of the government's budget on Tuesday, to decide on possible courses of action.

The CGSP and fellow public services union CSC held protest meetings throughout the country last Thursday in what they said was a response to fears the government would roll back pension and health care benefits as part of the budget.
